summary: Conditionally resets two dword fields at this+0x94 and this+0x98 to zero when bit 2 of the byte at this+0x9C is clear; otherwise the function returns immediately and leaves both fields untouched. Despite the canonical call-chain name suggesting accumulation, the raw body only ever zeroes these fields, so this reads as a conditional state reset rather than an accumulation step.

operations.description: Read the byte at this+0x9C; if (value & 2) != 0, skip the zeroing block and fall through to the early return.
Zero the dword field at this+148 (this+0x94).
Zero the dword field at this+152 (this+0x98).
Return result, which is 0 on the zeroing path and unassigned on the guarded-out path.
